description: Parse a portlet-collection XML wire document back into a portlet collection, tolerating and ignoring descriptive elements that are not part of the record model, and report the reconstructed state as a deterministic dump giving the portlet count and, per portlet in document order, its identifier, class, parameter count, and each parameter as a sorted name/value line. These cases exercise boundary inputs: an empty collection, a record with no initialization parameters, and multiple records interspersed with several kinds of unmodeled descriptive elements.

cases.expected_output:
portlets=2
[0] id=first
[0] class=com.dotcms.First
[0] init_count=1
[0] init.view-action=/ext/first
[1] id=second
[1] class=com.dotcms.Second
[1] init_count=2
[1] init.edit-action=/ext/second/edit
[1] init.view-action=/ext/second/view
